goal_context: Continue toward a complete Bominal-grade Oyatie mockup after the user rejected a prior regression. This slice closes the Work Hub communications gap; it does not claim the full dashboard objective is complete.

product_direction_applied.user_directive: Oyatie will build a hyperscaler-grade cloud substrate and dogfood all FD-001 microservices as tenant workloads on that substrate. FD-001 product delivery remains the master-plan product goal; Oyatie Cloud is the substrate that proves the platform can host real production tenants.
product_direction_applied.ui_interpretation: Messenger, Mail, and Community now coordinate FD-001 microservice tenant-workload dogfooding on Oyatie Cloud instead of appearing as detached communication demos.

change_summary: Inserted a dynamic and SSR-safe communication product board below the Work Hub output routes so each built-in surface has its own command deck.
Upgraded Messenger into an ops-room thread with transcript, action extraction, participants, local escalation, Mail promotion, and cloud receipt attachment controls.
Upgraded Mail into a formal approval brief composer with envelope fields, draft body, FD-001 evidence chips, approval checks, preview, attachment, and send-preview controls.

Upgraded Community into a governance council publication surface with pinned post, voting/comment/save controls, audience matrix, moderation state, pin/poll/publish controls, and role-aware local-only semantics.
Added template-backed board swapping for SSR fallback plus selective hydration behavior; route tabs/buttons swap boards and keep visible status updates coherent.
Reworded the Work Hub route/status copy so Messenger/Mail/Community visibly dogfood FD-001 tenant workloads on Oyatie Cloud while remaining local-only/no external send.

differences: Bominal Connect is used as a reference language for density, three-pane comms, Mail formalism, and Community moderation/voting; the result stays embedded in the cohesive Oyatie dashboard instead of cloning a separate app.
The visual treatment is intentionally Oyatie-native and cloud/workload-oriented, with FD-001 tenant workload and Oyatie Cloud evidence language replacing Bominal company-specific data.
The full-dashboard goal remains active; this verdict only covers the Work Hub Messenger/Mail/Community regression gap.
suggestions: Continue the same requirement-by-requirement audit across any remaining sparse dashboard panels before declaring the complete Oyatie mockup done.
If a future pass introduces a standalone Connect route, preserve this dashboard-integrated command board as the cross-product routing summary rather than replacing it.
visual_verdict.reasoning: Browser screenshots show three visually distinct, dense, functional command boards with local actions, route switching, status feedback, and product-language cohesion. The Work Hub now supports the explicit built-in Messenger, Mail, and Community requirement without becoming a separate mix of Bominal surfaces.

known_limits: This is a Work Hub communications parity slice; it does not prove the full Oyatie dashboard mockup objective is complete.
All Messenger, Mail, Community, route, draft, poll, receipt, preview, and publish controls remain local visual state with no backend, external send, or persistence wiring.
The browser console info about missing /pkg is expected for fallback smoke; the separate wasm32 hydration library build passed as the selective-hydration verification.
Pixel diff is not used as clone proof because the product target is cohesive Oyatie Cloud dogfooding, not a separate Bominal Connect copy.
